statement: The system-table cache maintains one monotonic per-table version advanced on every apply (CDC delivery and authoritative reconciliation alike); readiness snapshot reuse arbitrates on stored per-table versions instead of the node-heartbeat watermark, deleting the per-node atMs/independentAtMs invalidation markers, the cluster-wide invalidation timestamp, and the buildStartedAtMs TOCTOU back-stamping; complete-table observation publication becomes a version compare-and-set that deletes the post-apply exact-match table re-read, while gateway-minted receipts retain provenance, rows-array mutation detection, and single-use consumption; all existing readiness-store, reconciliation, and observation tests remain green.
